Hi, I’m Dr Lew - a Chiropractor and clinic owner at Sensorium Chiropractic in the UK.

On this channel I share real chiropractic adjustments, simple explanations about pain and the nervous system, and practical advice to help people move and feel better.

You’ll see real patient cases from the clinic, satisfying spinal adjustments, and clear breakdowns of how the body works, including why pain happens, how movement affects the nervous system, and what helps people recover and build confidence in their bodies again.

My goal is to make pain and movement easier to understand so people can take control of their health and build a stronger, more resilient body.

I post new videos regularly showing chiropractic care in practice and sharing honest education about pain, movement and healing.
